name: Yamaguchi

flag.description: A white emblem on a brown field: the kanji 山口 (Yamaguchi) drawn as a bird flying toward the sun.
flag.symbolism: The circle and the bird flying toward the sun hide 山 (yama) and 口 (guchi), and stand for unity and progress.

hook: Yamaguchi is the brown flag: its white bird is 山口 (Yamaguchi) flying with a mountain in its middle.
trivia: More prime ministers of Japan have come from Yamaguchi than from any other prefecture.
Shimonoseki, at its western tip, is famous for fugu, the pufferfish.
